title: Procedure tool: run the editorial checks (Humanus) on a draft or a saved version
description: Agents need to check their own drafts against the publication's policies and the section's policies, including the classifier lane, and get findings with spans. Expose the editorial-checks service (checkItemVersion from PR #425 / checkEditorial) as a papyrus host call, returning findings and lanes, and record the run like a newsroom check.
